thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU capacity critical — us-west-2 inference-prod queue growing fast. Paging @alex (oncall) and @sre-maya. Severity: P1. See initial surge and autoscaler failures.

alex (oncall): I'm on it, joining bridge. What do we know about scope?

sre-maya: Queue ~20k requests (tokens) across the batch router. Autoscaler attempted scale but ASG failed during LaunchTemplate attach. Errors in controller: 'InvalidInstanceProfile: instance profile not found' and repeated kubelet register timeouts.

alex (oncall): can you paste the autoscaler logs?

sre-maya: ```
2026-03-17T14:12:33Z cluster-autoscaler: ScaleUp: nodegroup gpu-prod-v5 request 4 -> launching
2026-03-17T14:12:48Z asg: Attach: LaunchTemplateVersion v5 -> error InvalidInstanceProfile
2026-03-17T14:13:05Z kubelet: register failed: token expired / cert not found
2026-03-17T14:13:30Z cluster-autoscaler: failed to join nodes: taint propagation timed out
```

infra-leah: I can confirm the LaunchTemplate v5 was rolled forward in the deploy pipeline earlier today, but the corresponding instance profile arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/redwood-gpu-prod-v5 is missing in the account — looks like a CI job removed it during a policy cleanup.

eng-ml-jon: Runtime is hitting our soft token limits and returning 429s to clients. We're also seeing higher latencies for queued requests. If nodes don't join soon the queue will continue to back up and we risk throttling more customers.

alex (oncall): Can we do a manual hotpool spin up as a fallback? @leah any objections?

infra-leah: I don't have permission to modify LT in prod (need infra-admin). I can open a quick elevated request but that will be slow. Alternative: we can launch an ad-hoc set of spot instances with an older LT (v4) that still has a valid instance profile and join them to the cluster. I can run that now.

eng-ml-jon: Please do — I'll update routing to include a temporary hotpool and reduce batch concurrency to ease backpressure.

product-amanda: Customer impact check: roughly 14 customers report latency > 10s, 3 customers seeing 500s on batch endpoints (errors). I'll prepare a status page update.

cust-bridge-eli: On a call with ACME right now — they report spikes of 500s on /v1/batch_infer and are asking if it's a platform outage. I'll bridge with ops.

alex (oncall): @leah proceed with ad-hoc v4 nodes. Jon, when you have the endpoint changes ready, push them. I'm triaging comms.

infra-leah: Spawning 4 x p4d-like fallback instances with LT v4 now (manually overriding instance profile). Command: `aws ec2 run-instances --launch-template LaunchTemplateId/Version:v4 --count 4` — starting.

sre-maya: Note: autoscaler still failing to attach nodegroup v5 because of missing instance profile. Also seeing `taint propagation timed out` because kube-controller-manager couldn't label/join nodes (kubelet errors). If the manual nodes join we'll get immediate capacity but autoscaler won't fix the root cause.

eng-ml-jon: Hotpool nodes registered: 4 new GPU nodes joined kube. I'm rebalancing the router and lowering batch concurrency from 16 -> 8 for 15m.

alex (oncall): Any change in backlog?

sre-maya: Backlog dropping from 20k -> 11k over 6 minutes. Request rate steady. Errors for ACME and 2 others reduced after routing to hotpool.

infra-leah: I've opened an infra-admin emergency PR to restore the missing instance profile and to rollback LT v5 -> v4 for the autoscaler nodegroup. Request ID: #PR-4821. Approvers pinged.

eng-ml-jon: Autoscaler health: once LaunchTemplate reverted, autoscaler should be able to attach new nodes normally. We'll keep manual hotpool while we wait for the PR to merge (~5-10m estimate).

product-amanda: Status: posting to status.redwood.ai — "Partial degradation: increased latencies and intermittent errors for some batch endpoints in us-west-2. Mitigation in progress." Will update customers on resolution timeline ~15m.

cust-bridge-eli: ACME is on the bridge, saw errors drop to a few 500s in the last minute. They're happy with mitigation.

incident-bot: UPDATE: manual hotpool added + autoscaler rollback in progress. Severity remains P1 until autoscaler can operate normally.

sre-maya: PR merged and LT reverted at 14:28:40Z. Autoscaler re-tried scale and launched 6 new nodes; kube join completed. New capacity observed. Backlog now 1.2k and dropping.

alex (oncall): Excellent. Can we remove temp hotpool after steady state? Jon, coordinate drain.

eng-ml-jon: Starting graceful drain of the 4 manual nodes. Estimated drain time 2m.

product-amanda: Status updated to: "Mitigated — capacity restored, customers seeing reduced latency. Root cause under investigation." Will send an email to impacted customers.

cust-bridge-eli: ACME confirms normal behavior now.

alex (oncall): Create postmortem ticket with owners. Main action items: 1) prevent LT/instance-profile mismatches in CI, 2) autoscaler runbook update to fallback to hotpool automatically, 3) tighter alerts on instance-profile changes. Owner: infra-leah.

infra-leah: ACK. Creating ticket INC-2026-0317-004 and scheduling postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: P1 -> mitigated at 1710804680. Follow-up: postmortem required. :white_check_mark:

alex (oncall): Thanks team. Will follow up in the incident channel with retrospective notes and timeline. :thumbsup:
